name: The Greatest Athletes of All Time
description: Runners, boxers, footballers and gymnasts whose records or courage defined a sport, from the first modern Olympics to the age of global television.

checkpoints.name: The early champions
checkpoints.note: The modern Olympics open in 1896, Thorpe, Ruth, Owens and Bradman become national heroes, and sport begins to be a stage for politics.

checkpoints.name: Postwar icons
checkpoints.note: Zátopek and Bikila stretch what runners can do, Robinson breaks baseball's colour bar, Ali becomes a voice beyond boxing, and Pelé wins three World Cups.

checkpoints.name: The television years
checkpoints.note: Comăneci's perfect ten, Maradona, Jordan and Navratilova play for audiences of millions, and sponsorship turns champions into global brands.

checkpoints.name: The record breakers
checkpoints.note: Bolt, Phelps, Serena Williams, Federer, Messi and Biles push records in the sports where the margins are smallest.
